message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_16051",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1049,"var":"data","code":"data = ctx->data;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Local pointer 'data' captures the current streaming buffer address before reading chunk bytes"},
   {"step":2,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1051,"var":"chunk.length","code":"ret = read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"read_chunk_bytes calls read_data which may realloc ctx->data if chunk.length > data_size (8192), invalidating the saved 'data' pointer"},
   {"step":3,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_data",
    "line":292,"var":"ctx->data","code":"void *buf = spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"In streaming mode, when bytes > ctx->data_size, ctx->data is reallocated. The old buffer (still referenced by local 'data' in the caller) is freed. The safety obligation is that the caller's 'data' pointer must equal ctx->data after this call."},
   {"step":4,"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1324,"var":"data","code":"memcpy(&ctx->splt_list[i].name, data, keyword_len);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reads from the stale 'data' pointer which points to freed heap memory, causing heap-use-after-free READ"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
     "line":1049,"operands":["data","ctx->data"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_data",
     "line":292,"operands":["data","ctx->data"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}},
   "sink":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
     "line":1324,"operands":["data","keyword_len"],
     "relation":{"op":"same_object","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
       "line":1049,"operands":["data"]},
      "to":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_data",
       "line":292,"operands":["ctx->data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["ctx->data"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}},
     {"from":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_data",
       "line":292,"operands":["ctx->data"]},
      "to":{"file":"spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
       "line":1324,"operands":["data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["data"],
      "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
